name: Geuraedo Geunyeoreul Geuriwohanda
source:
How far would you go, to take back your lover?
"I still miss her" is visual novel "Gal game" which you can conquer 4 beauty girls.
The antagonist "Jin-Tae" took your lover by using illegal drug. Now you must take back your lover and have revenge by taking the other lovers of Jin-Tae with a help of your Partner "Sin-Ah"

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?l=koreana&id=541549844]Steam Community[/url]]
translation:
为了夺回你的爱人，你愿意走多远？
《我依然想念她》是一款可以征服4位美少女的视觉小说“辣妹游戏”。
反派“Jin-Tae”用非法毒品夺走了你的爱人。现在你必须在你的搭档“Sin-Ah”的帮助下夺回你的爱人并报复Jin-Tae的其他爱人

[来自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?l=koreana&id=541549844]Steam社区[/url]]
